caveats: Per-cell MHWs are defined only over the target period (hot runs >=5 d, gaps of 1-2 d joined), as prescribed; no days outside 2008-06-01..2008-08-31 were used for run detection. Per the method, the +-5-day pools for baseline day-of-year windows extend up to 5 days beyond the 1992-2002 baseline (1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 were used); 29 February values enter their calendar neighbours' pools and day 60 (29 Feb) is set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. Threshold (hazen/type-5 90th percentile) and climatology (mean) were smoothed with a wrap-around centred 31-day moving mean over 366 day-of-year values. Land/undefined cells (306 of 3600; 3294 sea cells, finite on every target day) are masked 0. SST used as stored in the dataset (analysed_sst, kelvin, float64 arithmetic).
